<objective>
Build the three shared input widgets the Intimacy editor is made of: the rating meter (DSGN-04 radiogroup, INTM-01 click-to-clear), the lean slider (INTM-02), and the autosize textarea directive (INTM-04). Each supports both `edit` and `view` modes (D-13).

Purpose: these are leaf components with no dependency on the plugin architecture, so they build in parallel with the tracer; plan 02-06 composes them into the 46 rating cards, two sliders and nine text areas.
Output: `Meter`, `LeanSlider`, `AutosizeTextarea` with component specs.
</objective>

    - level 3: clicking glyph 3 emits 0; clicking glyph 2 emits 2; clicking glyph 4 emits 4

    - view mode: no role radio or radiogroup, no tabindex attributes, clicks emit nothing; the container has role img and aria-label "Experience: Oral (giving), Comfortable, 4 of 6" (or ", not rated" at level 0); filled glyphs and the word still render
  </behavior>
  <action>
Create `Meter` (selector `cd-meter`, OnPush), exporting `MeterLevel`.
- Inputs: `level = input.required<MeterLevel>()`, `words = input.required<readonly string[]>()` (6 entries), `kind = input<'dot' | 'heart'>('dot')`, `groupLabel = input.required<string>()`, `label = input.required<string>()` (the short visible row label, "Experience" or "Enjoyment"), `mode = input<'edit' | 'view'>('edit')`.
- Output: `levelChange = output<MeterLevel>()`. The component holds no copy of the level (the parent owns data): it emits, and the new `level()` flows back.
- Template follows the prototype structure: `.meter-block` > `.meter-top` (`.meter-label` text from `label()`, then `.meter`) and `.meter-word`.
  - Edit mode: `.meter` has `role="radiogroup"` and `[attr.aria-label]="groupLabel()"`. Glyphs render from a 6-item `@for` with `track $index`, as `<span #glyph role="radio">` with `[attr.aria-label]` = word, `[attr.aria-checked]`, `[attr.tabindex]` (roving) and `[class.filled]` when index < level. Hearts contain ♥ as `aria-hidden` text.
  - View mode: the `.meter` element gets `role="img"` and the composed aria-label, glyphs have no role, tabindex or listeners, and the word line is not live.
- `select(n)`: emits `n === level() ? 0 : n`, matching prototype setLevel (INTM-01).
- `onKeydown(event, index)`: ArrowRight/ArrowDown go to `min(max(level(), 0) + 1, 6)`, where an unset level moves to 1. ArrowLeft/ArrowUp go to `max(level() - 1, 1)`, emitting nothing when already at 1; at level 0 ArrowLeft emits nothing. Home goes to 1 and End to 6. Space emits 0 when `index + 1 === level()`, else `index + 1`. Delete and Backspace emit 0. Emit only when the value differs from level(). Always `preventDefault()` for handled keys. After an emit that sets n > 0, focus `glyphs()[n - 1]` via `viewChildren('glyph')`.
- "Cleared" announcement: a private `cleared = signal(false)` set true when a user action emits 0. An effect resets it when `level()` becomes non-zero. The word line renders the word when level > 0; otherwise, when `cleared()`, a `.visually-hidden` span "Cleared".
- SCSS: port the prototype meter CSS with tokens only.
  - Glyph visual is 12 px, with a hit area of at least 24 × 24 px through padding/box sizing and `cursor: pointer`.
  - `.meter-top` gets `flex-wrap: wrap`.
  - Filled dot: `--accent` background and border. Filled heart: `--accent` colour.
  - Hover changes only the border colour or colour to `--accent` (no transform, per design-system §2).
  - Transitions only on background/border-color/color at `--motion-fast`.
  - Group focus ring: `.meter:has(:focus-visible) { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }`, with glyph outlines removed.
  - `.meter-word` uses the `--text-meter-word` role (mono 11px accent), `min-height: 1.2em`, `padding-left: 67px`.
  - A local `.visually-hidden` utility.
  - Keep the file under 4 kB.
  </action>
  <verify>
    <automated>pnpm --filter web exec ng test --watch=false --include=src/app/components/meter/meter.component.spec.ts</automated>
    <fails_when>non-zero exit, or "No tests found" in the output</fails_when>
  </verify>
  <acceptance_criteria>
    - The spec passes with an `it(...)` per behavior bullet.
    - `rg -q 'role="radiogroup"' apps/web/src/app/components/meter/meter.component.html` exits 0 and `rg -q 'aria-live' apps/web/src/app/components/meter/meter.component.html` exits 0.
    - `rg -q 'scale\(' apps/web/src/app/components/meter/meter.component.scss` exits 1.
    - `rg -q ':has\(:focus-visible\)' apps/web/src/app/components/meter/meter.component.scss` exits 0.
  </acceptance_criteria>
  <done>A meter can be set, cleared and moved entirely by keyboard or pointer, announces words rather than counts, and renders statically in view mode.</done>

  <action>
`LeanSlider` (selector `cd-lean-slider`, OnPush), exporting `LeanValue`:
- Inputs: `value = input.required<LeanValue>()`, `words = input.required<readonly string[]>()` (5 entries), `name = input.required<string>()` (e.g. "Dominant ↔ submissive"), `endLabels = input.required<readonly [string, string]>()`, `inline = input(false)`, `mode = input<'edit' | 'view'>('edit')`.
- Output: `valueChange = output<LeanValue>()`.
- The input id comes from a module-level counter (`lean-slider-1`, `-2`, …) assigned at construction.
- Edit template follows the prototype buildLean: `.lean` `[class.inline]`, `.lean-head` holding a `<label class="name" [for]>` plus `<span class="value">` with the word, `.lean-track` holding `<input type="range" min="0" max="4" step="1" [value]="value()" [attr.aria-valuetext]="words()[value()]">`, and `.lean-ends` with two spans. On input, parse `Number(target.value)` and emit only when `Number.isInteger(n) && n >= 0 && n <= 4`.
- View template: the same head with the word in `<strong>`, a `.lean-track.static` div with `role="img"` and aria-label `name: word` containing a positioned `.lean-marker` (`[style.left.%]="value() * 25"`), and the ends.
- SCSS: port prototype lean CSS with tokens. Keep the semantic pole gradient (accent → border-strong → accent at 0.85 opacity) and the 18 px thumb with a 2.5 px accent border and the permitted `0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.25)` shadow. `.lean.inline` has no top border and max-width 420 px. Show a focus-visible ring on the thumb.

`AutosizeTextarea` (directive, selector `textarea[cdAutosize]`, standalone):
- Input `cdAutosize = input<string>('')` carries the bound text so value changes can be observed.
- Host bindings: `(input)` calls `resize()`; `[style.resize]` 'none', `[style.overflow]` 'hidden', `[style.min-height.px]` 44.
- `resize()` sets `el.style.height = 'auto'` and then `el.style.height = (el.scrollHeight + 2) + 'px'` (prototype autosize verbatim).
- `afterRenderEffect` reads `cdAutosize()` and calls `resize()`, covering "after data load" (SPEC-design-system §4.10).
  </action>

<threat_model>
## Trust Boundaries

| Boundary | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| DOM input events to emitted values | Range and keyboard input become persisted integers |

## STRIDE Threat Register

| Threat ID | Category | Component | Severity | Disposition | Mitigation Plan |
|-----------|----------|-----------|----------|-------------|-----------------|
| T-02-02-01 | Tampering | LeanSlider input parsing | low | mitigate | Emit only integers 0-4 (spec rejects 2.5, 7, empty); the schema literal union rejects anything else at load (02-01). |
| T-02-02-02 | Tampering | Meter emitted levels | low | mitigate | Emitted values are computed from fixed indices, clamped 0-6; no free-form input. |
| T-02-02-03 | Denial of Service | autosize on very long text | low | accept | Text is capped at 4,000 code points by schema and maxlength; one reflow per input is bounded. |
</threat_model>
